payload.summary: DSM-5-TR specifier catalogue: 515 of 585 items await clinician review, including the reset DID possession-form item
payload.detail: PS-062 correction verified 2026-10-18: the owner reset the DID possession-form sign-off under docs/decisions/2026-10-17-agent-recorded-therapy-and-did-sign-offs-reset.md. The previous statement that all 71 written disorder-specific items were signed is superseded: 70 remain signed and one written DID item plus 514 unwritten placeholders await review (515 pending). The 18 universal specifiers remain separate. Preserve all earlier worklist and clinician-only acceptance requirements; no new clinical approval is supplied. PRIOR DETAIL retained as superseded historical context (its all-signed/514-pending prose is corrected above): UPDATE 2026-10-17: All 71 written disorder-specific specifier items and 18 universal specifiers are signed off by Psych Sift with SHA-256 content pins (including the updated Dissociative Identity Disorder possession-form specifier wording); 514 unwritten catalog placeholders remain. PRIOR DETAIL (restored 2026-10-09, an earlier update replaced it wholesale): UPDATE 2026-09-25 (offline traversal of data/specifiers-content.json; no provider access). Two corrections to this row's own headline, both reproducible from the committed file. FIRST: '71 source-verified' overstates the work. 57 of the 71 restate their own label, matching 'For <disorder>, <label> uses the stated threshold: <the label's own parenthesis>' — the Adjustment Disorders entry for 'Acute (less than 6 months)' resolves to 'uses the stated threshold: less than 6 months'. Only 14 carry content beyond the label, all in the ICD-11 trauma, dissociative, ARFID and personality material. Real coverage is 14 of 585, not 71. SECOND: neurodevelopmental, schizophrenia spectrum, bipolar, depressive and anxiety disorders hold 192 items and no definitions between them, so the commonest presentations are the least covered. SETTLED 2026-09-18 (owner instruction): the sign-off value is clinician-reviewed-approved, set only by a named clinician; the unit of work is one definition per specifier plus per-disorder exception notes; severity and remission for sexual dysfunctions and paraphilic disorders (41 of 164 undefined severity items) are out of scope. PR #3028 made the audit recognise clinician-reviewed-approved — under the previous exact-match test the first signed specifier would have gone unexamined. WORKLIST AND FIRST ENTRY, both on main from PR #2879: docs/specifier-definition-worklist-2026-09-18.md (A/B/C triage; Group A is 63 management-changing rows carrying only 17 distinct labels) and docs/specifier-entry-worksheet-with-catatonia.md (all nine disorders enumerated, every clinical statement blank). NEXT ACTION is clinician-only: write the four blanks in section 1 of the worksheet. No agent writes the clinical text.
